llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam characteristics: offering unusually high and rapid returns (10% in 24 hours), claiming licensing in over 120 countries without verifiable evidence, ambiguous and unprofessional company registration information (recent domain registered to an individual in Nigeria, generic organization), vague privacy statements, numerous psychological manipulation tactics (urgency, testimonials, free sign-up), and focus on cryptocurrency investment plans. These traits match the established profile of investment scam websites.
